fact: The HSSP V mid-term review data management report of March 2025 states that expanding GoT-HoMIS is a priority for PO-RALG and the Ministry of Health, that the Ministry plans to phase out vendor-dependent systems such as Medipro and E-Medical for unified government-owned ones, and that the Digital Health Strategy 2019-2024 drove the work with a 2025-2030 strategy and a UNICEF-supported investment roadmap in development; it gives more than 3,000 primary facilities using GoT-HoMIS, all 28 regional hospitals on Afya eHMS and, from SARA 2023, 44.9% of health centres and 10.6% of dispensaries using GoT-HoMIS.
title: Mid-Term Review (MTR) of the Health Sector Strategic Plan V (HSSP V): Data Management Report
